title: Ankhorage Supabase Database Adapter
summary: Adapts Supabase Postgres to portable Ankhorage database contracts with CRUD, administration, query, and optional realtime behavior.
purpose: Provide a Supabase-backed database boundary without coupling consumers to provider-specific query and realtime details.
responsibilities: Implement portable CRUD and query operations through a Supabase client.
Expose schema administration behavior supported by the adapter.
Provide optional realtime subscriptions and validate adapter inputs.
Map provider failures into the adapter's public error boundary.
boundaries: Does not define portable database contracts.
Does not provision Supabase projects, databases, credentials, or network policy.
Does not replace provider-specific migrations or application domain repositories.
audience: Applications selecting Supabase as the backing database provider.
Composition code requiring portable database operations over a Supabase client.
useCases: Perform CRUD and filtered queries through the adapter.
Manage supported schema operations against Supabase Postgres.
Subscribe to supported realtime database changes.

architecture.role: Outbound provider adapter translating portable database contracts to Supabase APIs.
invariants: Portable operations remain independent of the concrete Supabase client type at consumer boundaries.
Provider inputs are validated before requests are executed.
Realtime behavior remains optional and separately owned.

limitations: Requires a compatible Supabase JavaScript client and reachable project.
Administration and realtime capabilities are constrained by Supabase permissions and features.
